turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Grandma, please do not worry, this is about your grandson Marek.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He had a car accident near Krakow and needs help immediately.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am his lawyer. A courier will collect 8,000 zloty in cash for the hospital today.

turns.speaker: elder
turns.text: I need to call my daughter.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please keep this secret so Marek does not panic.
